rationale: Direct precedent (ENH-3224 abstain_on_exit_3 field-threading), free MR-14 lint coverage via evaluate_config_known_fields(), and baseline_score already sits outside the iterate cycle so no new executor primitive is needed. Option B is not directly buildable as described: StateDef.evaluate is single-valued per state, forcing a second chained state with a disjoint route vocabulary and zero shipped precedent, plus stacks LLM cost onto an already LLM-heavy loop.
rule: Option A: frozen-reference field on EvaluateConfig/evaluate_convergence()
alternatives_rejected: Option B: wire check_comparator into harness-optimize.yaml's gate state as a second required check
